Create one premium photorealistic wide industrial photograph, ultra-wide composition approximately 3:1 (prefer 2400x800). Cool graphite, steel and deep navy palette with restrained blue lighting matching a navy website. The existing white heading and paragraph will overlay the LEFT half, so keep the left 55% dark, calm and low-detail with natural industrial negative space, not a blank black rectangle; concentrate sharp machinery and the subject on the RIGHT 45%, with generous framing for responsive crops. Realistic materials, credible industrial construction, polished architectural photography, controlled highlights, no neon, no sci-fi holograms, no illustration, no people, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. This is a decorative thematic generated image, not documentary evidence of a specific customer facility. Scene:
